## Automated Tests Required

### S4-03: PranaGrid Skeleton + Phase Gating — Logic

**Test file**: `tests/unit/prana-grid/prana_grid_phase_gating_test.gd`
**GDD reference**: `design/gdd/prana-grid.md` — Rules 2, 3, 3a; Formulas 1; Edge Cases

**What to test**:
- `preparation_started` → all 9 slots null, state = ARRANGEMENT (AC-PG-01)
- `preparation_started` received from LOCKED state → slots reset, ARRANGEMENT entered (AC-PG-01)
- `preparation_started` received from HIDDEN state → slots reset, ARRANGEMENT entered (AC-PG-01)
- `grid_locked` received → state = LOCKED, all input ignored (AC-PG-02)
- `grid_hidden` received → state = HIDDEN
- Slot index formula: all 9 positions return correct index via `row × 3 + col` (Formula 1)
- Centre slot is index 4: `row=1, col=1 → slot_index=4` (Formula 1)
- `grid_locked` received without prior `arrangement_confirmed` → `committed_fragments` all-null, no crash (GDD Edge Case: sequencing bug path)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- All 9 slots filled, then `preparation_started` → all 9 become null (not just centre)
- `preparation_started` fires while a drag is in progress → drag cancelled, slots reset (GDD Edge Case)
- Same Prana type placed in all 9 slots → valid, no validation error (GDD Edge Case)

**Estimated test count**: ~9 unit tests

---

### S4-04: Mouse Input + Confirm — Logic Sub-tests

**Test file**: `tests/unit/prana-grid/prana_grid_confirm_logic_test.gd`
**GDD reference**: `design/gdd/prana-grid.md` — Rules 6, 7, 8; Formulas 2; Edge Cases; AC-PG-03–08, AC-PG-10–11

**What to test**:
- `arrangement_confirmed` fires exactly once when slot 4 is filled and Confirm triggered (AC-PG-03)
- `committed_fragments` length is always 9 — `committed_fragments.size() == 9` (Formula 2)
- `committed_fragments[4]` is non-null after confirmation (Formula 2 invariant, AC-PG-03)
- Empty slots in `committed_fragments` are `null` — not -1 or 0 (Formula 2)
- Fragment `type_id` matches the Prana type placed in each slot (AC-PG-03, Formula 2)
- Fragment `level == 1` at First Playable scope (Formula 2, lv.1 constraint)
- Confirm blocked when slot 4 is empty — no signal emitted (AC-PG-04, AC-PG-05)
- Slot replace: place type B on slot holding type A → `committed_fragments[N].type_id` == type B (AC-PG-06)
- Slot clear → `committed_fragments[N] == null` (AC-PG-07)
- Clear All → all 9 slots null, Confirm becomes disabled (AC-PG-08)
- `committed_fragments` does not mutate during LOCKED state (AC-PG-10)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Centre slot only (all others empty) → valid confirmation; slots 0–3, 5–8 are null (minimum valid arrangement)
- All 9 slots filled with same type → valid; all 9 elements non-null, all same `type_id` (GDD Rule 5)
- Drag in-progress when `grid_locked` fires → no partial placement; array reflects pre-drag arrangement (AC-PG-11)

**Estimated test count**: ~12 unit tests

---

### S4-05: PranaGrid → CR + SCE Integration — Integration

**Test file**: `tests/integration/prana-grid/prana_grid_cr_integration_test.gd`
**GDD reference**: `design/gdd/prana-grid.md` — Dependencies; AC-PG-10; Formula 2

**What to test**:
- After `combat_started`, CombinationResolution reads `committed_fragments` and receives a length-9 array (AC-PG-10)
- `committed_fragments[4]` is non-null when read by CR after a valid confirmation (AC-PG-10)
- Full loop: `preparation_started` → place tokens → confirm → `combat_started` → CR resolves combo → SCE fires cast
- `committed_fragments` unchanged throughout Combat Phase — no mutation from CR or SCE reads (AC-PG-10)
- SCE reads `type_id` per non-null element — no null-pointer errors on empty slots

**Edge cases to cover**:
- All-null arrangement (no prior confirmation) → CR handles gracefully without crash (GDD Edge Case: sequencing bug path)

**Estimated test count**: ~5 integration tests

## Manual QA Checklist

### S4-04: Mouse Input + Confirm — UI Verification

**Verification method**: Developer manual walkthrough + screenshot evidence
**Who must sign off**: Developer (solo dev)
**Evidence**: `production/qa/evidence/prana-grid-mouse-evidence.md`

- [ ] Token drag from Type Selector renders a drag ghost following the cursor
- [ ] Valid drop target slot shows a pulsed highlight ring during hover
- [ ] Token placed in slot renders with correct Prana type color per Art Bible:
  - Ashfire `#F24C1D`, Voidblue `#4A5EF5`, Stormgold `#FFCC00`, Deepfrost `#3DD9F0`, Verdant `#1AC953`
- [ ] Token placed in slot renders with correct type icon (icon + color, not color alone)
- [ ] Confirm button greyed out (40% opacity, non-interactive) when slot 4 is empty (AC-PG-04)
- [ ] Confirm button enabled (full opacity, interactive) when slot 4 is filled
- [ ] Pressing Enter with slot 4 empty produces: grid border flash + "place a fragment in the centre slot" label (AC-PG-05)
- [ ] Grid dims to 70% opacity after `grid_locked`; arrangement still readable (AC-PG-12)
- [ ] Type Selector panel becomes non-interactive in LOCKED state
- [ ] Centre slot (index 4) has subtle visual distinction (accent ring or similar) from surrounding slots

### S4-07: Gamepad Input — ADR-0013 Manual Validation

**Verification method**: Manual test with gamepad connected — validated independently from mouse path
**Who must sign off**: Developer (ADR-0013 HIGH risk verification required)
**Evidence**: `production/qa/evidence/prana-grid-gamepad-adr0013.md`

- [ ] D-pad navigates all 9 slots without skipping or wrapping incorrectly
- [ ] Cursor highlight (white/gold border, 1.05× scale) visible on currently selected slot
- [ ] Type Cycle control advances through all 5 Prana types in order
- [ ] Type Indicator widget shows currently selected type (color + icon)
- [ ] Place action fills cursor slot with selected type
- [ ] Clear action removes token from cursor slot
- [ ] Confirm (from Confirm button focus) emits `arrangement_confirmed` when slot 4 is filled
- [ ] **ADR-0013 dual-input test**: switch from mouse to gamepad mid-arrangement (and back) — no crash, no lost tokens, input mode transitions cleanly
- [ ] Full end-to-end gamepad-only: navigate → cycle type → place tokens → confirm → combat starts (AC-PG-09)

### S4-06: External Playtest — Fun Hypothesis Final Verdict

**Verification method**: Observed playtest session with a non-developer tester
**Who must sign off**: Developer
**Evidence**: `production/playtests/playtest-sprint-4-external-[date].md`

- [ ] Tester independently arranges Prana grid with intent (not randomly) within 10 minutes of first play
- [ ] Tester verbally identifies an elemental strategy without prompting
- [ ] All-Ashfire is NOT the tester's first strategy
- [ ] Tester discovers the 2× elemental weakness bonus within 5 minutes (no tooltip shown)
- [ ] Tester does not get stuck in a confusion loop >30 seconds
- [ ] Fun hypothesis verdict recorded: **CONFIRMED / PARTIALLY / NOT CONFIRMED**

> ⚠️ If verdict is NOT CONFIRMED: halt Feature layer; do not plan Sprint 5 scope until a design rethink session has produced a revised hypothesis.

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off for Sprint 4:

1. Game launches without crash
2. Preparation Phase loads with PranaGrid visible and in ARRANGEMENT state
3. Player can place tokens in grid, confirm arrangement, and transition to Combat Phase
4. `arrangement_confirmed` triggers: CR resolves combo, SCE fires cast — full prep→cast loop
5. Grid enters LOCKED state and remains visible at 70% opacity during combat wave
6. Wave runs to completion (win or loss path) — S3-11 regression: no crash or softlock

*Run via `/smoke-check sprint` after all Must Have stories are implemented.*
